decisions.decision: The minutes were tabled (no vote recorded).
decisions.quote: public comment: brian lehtinen said he had a school committee meeting at 7pm. minutes were tabled.

decisions.decision: Greg Roy told the town manager not to attend the meeting and would give the update himself.
decisions.quote: greg roy stated he told the town manager not to come tonight and he would give the update.

decisions.decision: Tentative meeting dates discussed: the 4th, or the 11th and 25th, for placeholders; no meeting next week unless the architect is ready or there is pressing business. Stated as probable, not voted.
decisions.quote: greg roy stated probably the 4th or the 11th and 25th for placeholders. we would not meet next week unless the architect is ready or we have pressing business.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The town manager had not given the overall price; the contract still needed work to be acceptable, and the town manager had gone back to the architect asking for a la carte items.
budget_items.quote: she didn't give the overall price but still needs work to be done to get an acceptable contract.

budget_items.topic: Past borrowing and hazardous material cost
budget_items.what_was_recorded: Tanner Cole recalled the last borrowing over a $10 million price tag, with hazardous material costing $800,000.
budget_items.quote: i can remember the last borrowing we did over a $10 million price tag. hazardous material was $800,000.

budget_items.topic: Estimate next door and possible cost
budget_items.what_was_recorded: Dave Passios said a good estimate next door was $300,000 and the project could easily reach $800,000.
budget_items.quote: dave passios stated a good estimate next door was $300,000; you could easily get to $800,000.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Tanner Cole said Johnson and Roberts did a $23 million project that could be compared with the committee's project.
budget_items.quote: johnson and roberts did a $23 million project and could compare our project

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Dave Passios said the finance committee would review fire department and police budgets the next evening; no figures printed.
budget_items.quote: the finance committee meeting is tomorrow evening and will be reviewing fire department and police budgets.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Tanner Cole said the only argument for postponing to a special election was cost savings; no figures printed.
budget_items.quote: tanner cole stated the only argument to that is cost savings to have a special election.
